interop_requirements: Every actual producer MUST include explicit integer version:1, including nested offer under the existing MessageContent serializer.
Consume actual Kotlin exports with actual Swift decoders and actual Swift exports with actual Kotlin decoders.
Compare all typed identity, offset, hash, SDP and reason fields; do not require JSON key ordering or optional null serialization byte equality.
The fixed-now field is for deterministic metadata validation, not permission to bypass runtime offer expiry.
Required offer_nonce must survive actual nested MessageContent and every actual control producer/consumer; missing old pre-release offers safely fall back, never activate.
claim_boundary: Typed serialization/validation fixtures only; synthetic hashes and fingerprint are not file-content or live Signal/DTLS evidence.

nonce_contract.encoding: standard canonical RFC4648 base64, exactly 32 decoded bytes and 44 ASCII characters including padding
nonce_contract.generation: 32 cryptographically random bytes per new production offer, generated before durable offer enqueue
nonce_contract.scope: inside existing Signal offer and every pairwise Signal control only; never HTTP metadata, URL, logs, or diagnostics
nonce_contract.binding: compare decoded bytes against immutable local original offer before any control effects, RTC, source or partial-file access
nonce_contract.limitations: Proves original-offer possession against post-offer newly inserted device keys; original Signal directory/TOFU verification remains a separate trust boundary.
